note: Private test IPA 759, for the maintainer's report of 16 November 2026 after the IPA 758 test ("Les artefacts violet sont encore plus visibles et nombreux", two screenshot frame captures and the log, then "aide toi avec ce github : https://github.com/cheemu21/plumber-racer-2") and the maintainer's answer "759 avec MeloNX": the verified IPA 758 (run 43812588474, IPA 7f873529) with (1) the S2Arm engine of patches 0001-0050 (run 43825107808, artifact 14207021472, verified pin acda5e89) and (2) the MeloNX session's new MeloNX Core (Core 127b72b9 of the lot after IPA 748-751 with the Nextendo online engine lot, run 43827244503, artifact 14206574778, verified pin c19e10dba). Patch 0050: Mario Kart World maps its terrain-cache arrays in pairs over the same physical pages (each pair's pools mapped by the same requests in 758's log), writes one set through the GPU (31565 / 31566 / 31567) and samples the other (31562 / 31563 / 31564); the tiled levels' tiles were already shared by physical memory, but each layer's mip tail was a tile of its own, uploaded from guest memory, which the GPU's writes never reach (level 5 of layer 0 of 31562 and 31564 magenta, all-zero ASTC blocks, in both captures): a tail of one 64 KB physical run is now shared too, keyed by the texture's shape; and 2,231 render-target upgrades in 758's 125 s log, all of textures taken from their storage (the game's dynamic-resolution targets), are avoided by making such a texture, with no packaged layout and in a colour format Apple GPUs render to, with render-target use (S2A_RB_CPU_RT=0 in env.txt turns it off). The MeloNX Core: the lot after IPA 748-751 (nine adapters) and the Nextendo online lot wired into the Core, DMA Core contract fd409792, 109 local gates, written, verified and pinned by the MeloNX session, nothing measured on an iPhone; the Nextendo online engine files it wires in are promoted from their deferred commits. The RPCS3 Core, XeniaCore, the app and every other retained component are those of the base; the app-side MeloNX overlay, the Nextendo app commits (RSwitch naming) and the RetroAchievements fork-gate commits stay source only. Images that must change: MeloNXCore, S2ArmEngine and Runner. Build-only delivery: Flutter/native groups not-run. Nothing has run on an iPhone; no claim that the pink is gone, that the stutters are fewer or that MeloNX behaves as before until the maintainer's test.
